overview.title: Company Overview
overview.description: PT Farrasindo Perkasa was established to address the challenges and demands of major cities in Indonesia, particularly the limited availability of land for office facilities, commercial infrastructure, and residential development. The implementation of regional autonomy is seen as an opportunity to observe the growth of modern cities, characterized by increasingly taller skyscrapers and the development of ready-mix concrete-based housing.

groupOverview.title: Farrasindo Group
groupOverview.description: For more than two decades, Farrasindo Group has been contributing to the development of Indonesia. Our business lines span across Mining, Concrete Machinery, Cranes, Spare Parts, and Services. All business units collaborate from upstream to downstream to meet the construction needs of communities throughout Indonesia.

founderMessage.title: Message from Our Founder

signature.name: Encep Suherman
signature.title: Founder of Farrasindo Group / President Director of Farrasindo Group

paragraphs: We are proud of the journey that has taken us from humble beginnings to becoming one of Indonesia’s leading construction equipment and service companies. It all started with a single concrete pump unit, a commitment to hard work, and a vision to improve construction efficiency nationwide.
Over time, through perseverance and dedication to excellence, we grew Farrasindo Group into a fleet of more than 300 units, serving projects across multiple industries.

Our company has expanded its services and is now involved in various sectors, from heavy equipment rental to the production of construction materials such as ready-mix and precast concrete. Each step of our growth is guided by the same core principles—integrity, reliability, and a passion for helping our clients achieve their construction goals.

Our aspiration is to provide builders, contractors, and developers across Indonesia with the equipment and services they need to realize their visions—whenever and wherever they need them. At Farrasindo Group, we are committed to making this vision a reality and contributing to a stronger, more connected Indonesia.

historyDetail.title: History of Farrasindo Perkasa
paragraphs: PT Farrasindo Perkasa was established to respond to the challenges faced by major cities in Indonesia, particularly limited land availability for office, commercial, and residential infrastructure.

Regional autonomy provided an opportunity for PT Farrasindo Perkasa to observe the development of modern global cities characterized by taller skyscrapers, modern shopping centers, and ready-mix concrete-based housing, ensuring building quality and durability.
Concrete pumps are the most effective solution to maintain concrete freshness and quality while significantly accelerating construction work.
To support building owners and contractors in achieving fast and high-quality construction goals, Farrasindo focuses on concrete pump rental services and spare parts supply.

Farrasindo Perkasa (FP) is a concrete construction equipment rental company founded on October 3, 2001, by experienced practitioners in the ready-mix concrete industry, consistently prioritizing quality, speed, and punctuality.

Driven by the goal of helping contractors and building owners achieve efficient construction while maintaining concrete strength and quality, we focus on fast concrete pouring solutions to keep concrete fresh through concrete pump rental and spare parts services.
